projectEvidence.prompt: Inspect tested Node major, lockfile, canonical server source, built entrypoint, build and startup.
Inspect public/private roots, hostname, injected-port contract and provider runtime controls.
Inspect health/readiness, APIs, static output, errors, proxy, cookies, logging and restart.
Inspect previous artifact, dependencies and runtime rollback owner.

decisions.question: Does this runtime require durable storage or identity?

projectChanges.description: Adapt minimal runtime behavior in the canonical server.
Adapt a CommonJS shim only when required by the actual host.
Record names and safe startup requirements, never values.
Record exact runtime artifact and recovery reference.
Adapt route/startup tests and browser checks.

externalActions.effect: Create/edit only the approved Node application, runtime and startup binding.
externalActions.verification: Verify exact artifact, public health/readiness, routes and redacted logs.
externalActions.rollback: Restore previous approved artifact/settings and repeat the prior baseline.

externalActions.effect: Set reviewed environment names/values through the approved provider store.
externalActions.verification: Verify exact artifact, public health/readiness, routes and redacted logs.
externalActions.rollback: Restore previous approved artifact/settings and repeat the prior baseline.

externalActions.effect: Install reviewed production dependencies and restart the selected application.
externalActions.verification: Verify exact artifact, public health/readiness, routes and redacted logs.
externalActions.rollback: Restore previous approved artifact/settings and repeat the prior baseline.

approvalGates.scope: Scoped application action at the exact approved provider application.
Scoped environment action at the exact approved provider application.
Scoped restart action at the exact approved provider application.

checks.instruction: Run adapted runtime tests and exact startup artifact on an injected local port.
checks.expected: One server; health/readiness and API/static/error boundaries pass.

checks.instruction: Run the local browser procedure for real routes/assets and repeat on the approved host.
checks.expected: Intended UI with no unexpected console/network errors.

checks.instruction: Compare host runtime, root, startup, proxy behavior, logs and recovery after approved restart.
checks.expected: Actual application matches approved artifact and recoverable baseline.

rollback.instruction: Restore prior artifact, reviewed dependencies and host settings after explicit recovery approval.
rollback.verification: Repeat prior health/readiness, route, asset, error and browser baseline.

acceptance.criterion: Exact runtime artifact passes local startup, route and browser checks.
Owner accepts verified host configuration and runtime recovery readiness.
